== Biography ==
Lavinia was born in 1806. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-822|John Glasgow]] and [[Arthur-2480|Mary Arthur]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-822]] is assessed at 97% (proved). John Glasgow and Mary Arthur’s family Bible includes Lavinia, born 21 June 1806, among the nine children after their 21 May 1798 marriage. The uncommon name and exact date define the child despite sparse later evidence.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.
